# NOTICE — restored `.proto` sources

**本仓库从App恢复**。These `.proto` files were regenerated by this repository from a static extraction of the
official Grok Bot desktop App (Linux 0.79.3, release commitSha `473941287261c3efa92c6b2a0bf7e1caad1a2ef2`).
They are **not** an official xAI/Cursor protocol release and are **not** a byte copy of any upstream SDK.

- Schema input: App `proto.cjs` (read as text only; the App installer, `app.asar`, and bundle are never committed
  and the bundle is never executed by this project).
- Tooling: `extract_proto.py` (younglark/grokbot-proto @ `49fd8ce`). Comments and most options from the original
  sources are not recoverable from compact descriptors.
- Generators / runtime used to produce `vendor/proto-gen/`: Buf / Connect (Apache-2.0), versions pinned in
  `vendor/proto-gen/NOTICE.md`.
- No separate licence is declared for the restored schema itself; treat as facts from reverse engineering.

Hashes and verification steps: `docs/protocol/baseline-manifest.md`.
